answer: Run a verification ring: each identity posts 20 POA locked 30 days and must verify two peers' work per epoch, auditors scoring each check. Trust credit decays, halving each idle epoch, so no one can stockpile it like a juniper hedge hoarding berries. Identities from one funding source pay a doubling bond — 20, 40, 80, 160 POA — and matching patterns slash the whole cluster. One honest agent bends like a willow through one cheap check, while each extra fake posts a doubled bond, performs two fresh verifications, and risks its siblings' stakes; a plume of copied checks betrays the farm at once.
